# ToolRank: full rankings

Last updated 2026-10-15. Source: https://toolrank.io/. Editorial ranking; position 1 = top pick. Pricing labels: free / freemium / paid (as listed; verify with vendor).


## Best for vibe coding

Describe an app in plain English, get a working app.
Page: https://toolrank.io/best/vibe-coding/

1. Lovable (freemium; audience: consumer): Prompt-to-full-stack web app builder aimed at non-developers. https://lovable.dev
2. Bolt.new (freemium; audience: consumer): Builds and runs full-stack apps in the browser from a prompt. https://bolt.new
3. v0 (freemium; audience: consumer): Vercel's generator for React/Next.js UIs and apps, deploys to Vercel. https://v0.app
4. Replit (freemium; audience: both): Replit Agent builds, hosts and deploys apps from one cloud workspace. https://replit.com
5. Base44 (freemium; audience: both): Prompt-to-app builder with built-in database, auth and hosting; owned by Wix. https://base44.com
6. Google AI Studio (Build) (free; audience: both): Google's AI Studio builds and deploys Gemini-powered apps from a prompt. https://aistudio.google.com
7. Firebase Studio (free; audience: both): Google's cloud workspace for prototyping full-stack apps with Gemini. https://firebase.studio
8. Create.xyz (Anything) (freemium; audience: consumer): Prompt-to-app builder for web and mobile apps. https://www.createanything.com
9. Rork (freemium; audience: consumer): Builds native mobile apps (React Native) from a prompt. https://rork.com
10. Softgen (paid; audience: consumer): AI web app builder producing Next.js apps with Firebase/Supabase. https://softgen.ai
11. Tempo (freemium; audience: consumer): Visual React editor with AI that generates and edits code. https://www.tempo.new
12. Same (freemium; audience: consumer): Clones or builds web apps from a prompt or URL. https://same.new
13. Macaly (freemium; audience: consumer): Prompt-to-website and app builder for non-developers. https://www.macaly.com
14. Figma Make (freemium; audience: both): Figma's prompt-to-app feature that turns designs and prompts into working prototypes. https://www.figma.com/make/
15. Bubble (freemium; audience: both): Established no-code platform with an AI app generator. https://bubble.io
16. Glide (freemium; audience: both): No-code business apps from spreadsheets, with AI features. https://www.glideapps.com
17. Webflow (freemium; audience: both): Visual website builder with AI site and page generation. https://webflow.com
18. Framer (freemium; audience: both): Design-first website builder with AI page generation. https://www.framer.com
19. Dyad (free; audience: consumer): Free, local, open-source app builder; bring your own model keys. https://www.dyad.sh
20. vibe-wise (free; audience: consumer): Claude Code/Codex plugin that teaches you to build while AI writes the code. New open-source launch on GitHub. https://github.com/nykooi1/vibe-wise
21. scroll-craft (free; audience: consumer): Agent skill for building premium scroll-driven websites. New open-source launch on GitHub. https://github.com/nateherkai/scroll-craft
22. shadcn lint (free; audience: consumer): Agent-first linter for Tailwind design systems. New open-source launch on GitHub. https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint

## Best coding assistants

AI pair programmers for working developers.
Page: https://toolrank.io/best/coding-assistants/

1. Cursor (freemium; audience: business): AI-native code editor with strong agent mode and codebase context. https://www.cursor.com
2. Claude Code (paid; audience: business): Anthropic's terminal-based agentic coding tool. https://www.anthropic.com/claude-code
3. GitHub Copilot (freemium; audience: business): Most widely integrated assistant across IDEs and GitHub. https://github.com/features/copilot
4. OpenAI Codex (paid; audience: business): OpenAI's coding agent across CLI, IDE and cloud. https://openai.com/codex
5. Windsurf (freemium; audience: business): Agentic IDE alternative to Cursor. https://windsurf.com
6. Gemini CLI (free; audience: business): Google's open-source terminal coding agent powered by Gemini. https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli
7. JetBrains AI (Junie) (paid; audience: business): JetBrains' coding agent inside IntelliJ-based IDEs. https://junie.jetbrains.com/
8. Cline (free; audience: business): Open-source autonomous coding agent for VS Code; bring your own model. https://cline.bot
9. Kilo Code (freemium; audience: business): Open-source coding agent for VS Code and JetBrains. https://kilo.ai
10. Aider (free; audience: business): Open-source terminal pair programmer that commits to git. https://aider.chat
11. Amp (freemium; audience: business): Sourcegraph-born agentic coding tool for terminal and editors. https://ampcode.com
12. Zed (freemium; audience: business): Fast open-source code editor with built-in AI agent. https://zed.dev
13. Amazon Q Developer (freemium; audience: business): AWS coding assistant for IDEs and CLI. https://aws.amazon.com/q/developer/
14. Kiro (freemium; audience: business): AWS's spec-driven agentic IDE. https://kiro.dev
15. Augment Code (paid; audience: business): Coding agent built for large codebases with deep context. https://www.augmentcode.com
16. Devin (paid; audience: business): Cognition's autonomous software engineering agent. https://devin.ai
17. Factory (paid; audience: business): Droids: coding agents for terminal, IDE and CI. https://factory.com
18. Warp (freemium; audience: business): Agentic terminal and development environment. https://www.warp.dev
19. OpenCode (free; audience: business): Open-source terminal coding agent supporting many models. https://opencode.ai
20. Continue (freemium; audience: business): Open-source assistants and checks for IDE and CI. https://www.continue.dev
21. CodeRabbit (freemium; audience: business): AI code reviews on pull requests. https://www.coderabbit.ai
22. Qodo (freemium; audience: business): AI code review and test generation. https://www.qodo.ai
23. Magpie (freemium; audience: business): Menu-bar app to run any coding agent (Codex, Claude Code) on any model. New open-source launch on GitHub. https://usemagpie.ai
24. Mono (monocode) (freemium; audience: business): A GUI for your coding agents. New open-source launch on GitHub. https://usemono.dev
25. OmniRush (freemium; audience: business): Desktop coding agent with free access to frontier models. New open-source launch on GitHub. https://omnirush.ai
26. jevgrep (free; audience: business): CLI for coding agents to find code by asking what it does. New open-source launch on GitHub. https://github.com/dzhng/jevgrep
